name: atl-sdk-wasm
description: TypeScript SDK for Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Trello and Atlassian Admin (Cloud and Data Center) for browsers, workers and Deno, built on the atl Rust core compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build:ts: bun build ./js/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --external '*/pkg/atl_wasm.js' && dts-bundle-generator --silent --no-check --external-imports ../pkg/atl_wasm.js -o dist/index.d.ts js/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts
